summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term indices, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX and NDX with extremely low Put/Call ratios (SPXW 0.29, NDX 0.12). Significant directional conviction is seen in the massive accumulation of SPX 6000C and 5000C strikes for 2026 expirations, totaling billions in premium. Persistent interest is confirmed by multi-day accumulation of the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-05-15) totaling $3.29B over three sessions, signaling a sustained long-term upward bet. Traders should watch for continued strength in tech-heavy indices (NDX, QQQ) and monitor if the heavy SPX call premium triggers a volatility squeeze or if the massive SPX 7500P/7475P 2027 tail-risk hedges begin to expand.
